summary: Fastidious discusses a major summoning mistake he made on his free-to-play Season 1 account by spending resources on the First Blush banner without checking upcoming events. A few days later, a high-value Wish Summon event arrived featuring elite carries like Serpentemis and Talethia at the 300-summon milestone, which he can no longer guarantee. He strongly advises players to track the official Dragonheir Discord event and limited-time banner calendars before pulling on any temporary banners. For Wish Summon banners specifically, players should avoid pulling entirely unless they can guarantee hitting the 300-summon threshold for the premium hero.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: A game-changing poison DPS carry and premier target at the 300-pull milestone on the Wish Summon banner.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: One of the standout premium legendary options available to select on the Wish Summon banner.

heroes.name: Auster
heroes.note: Functions as one of the chief DPS units on an account right from the start.

heroes.name: Elecebre
heroes.note: A strong support character, though not a broad dominant carry for early account progression.

tips: Always check the official Dragonheir Discord announcements for limited-time event and summoning calendars covering up to 4 weeks in advance before spending summon dice.
Do not pull on the Wish Summon banner unless you are 100% sure you have enough resources to hit the 300-summon milestone (approx. 270 summons after rebate) for the guaranteed premium legendary hero.
If you cannot guarantee the 300-summon target on a Wish Summon banner, skip it completely and save your Heliolite Dice for a future premium banner instead of stopping halfway.
title: DO NOT MAKE THIS MISTAKE! Be Smarter Than Me ⁂ Dragonheir: Silent Gods
